name: Kitchen Local, LLC

about:
Kitchen Local, LLC was founded in 2013 in Amesbury, Massachusetts, occupying a 2,200-square-foot space at 14 Cedar Street Studios, a historic brick building that once housed the carriage and automotive manufacturer Chas. J. Henschel & Co. The facility sits at the intersection of the North Shore and Merrimack Valley regions, just over the New Hampshire border.

The company operates a certified shared-use commercial kitchen and storage facility, offering around-the-clock access to food entrepreneurs. Its services include kitchen workspace for food production, catering, baking, cooking classes, menu planning, training, recipe testing, photography, and product development. Kitchen Local also provides a 90-minute confidential consulting session for early-stage businesses, guides clients through permitting and licensing, assists with business concept and strategic planning, and helps promote participant businesses.

The kitchen serves chefs, bakers, small-scale food producers, farmers, and cooking and nutrition instructors. These clients use the space for commercial food production, catering, baking, cooking classes, menu planning, training, recipe testing, photography, and product development. The facility fosters a collaborative community of food entrepreneurs.

Kitchen Local positions itself as the North Shore and Merrimack Valley's first certified shared-use kitchen, emphasizing affordable access that eliminates the need for large upfront capital investment. The company highlights its permitting guidance, business consulting, and collaborative environment as key differentiators that reduce risk and start-up costs for food businesses.
